title: Does Heat Raise or Lower Blood Pressure? What Adults 35+ Need to Know
primaryKeyword: does heat raise or lower blood pressure
description: Heat typically lowers blood pressure by ~5–10 mmHg in healthy adults — but dehydration or heart conditions can reverse this. Learn how to monitor safely this summer.
reasoning: This query is spiking due to early summer heatwaves across North America and Europe; users (especially 45–75) are noticing real-time BP fluctuations at home, misreading them as dangerous, and seeking practical, non-clinical guidance on interpreting readings during hot weather — not textbook physiology.
